allowed_claim: A provider-neutral common-denominator shape is architecturally plausible when provider-internal retrieval remains the treatment, but current frozen authority is insufficient to freeze or execute it.

evidence_determinations.exact_hosts: NOT_DERIVABLE: frozen authority names SEC EDGAR and Microsoft Investor Relations source classes but contains no hostname or URL
evidence_determinations.provider_treatment: SUPPORTED_AS_DESIGN_SCOPE: frozen design says native capability differences are treatment effects while logical allowances and budgets remain matched
evidence_determinations.result_ceiling: NOT_FROZEN: Claude WebSearch exposes query and optional domain lists; Codex exposes qualitative response_length and multiple commands; no common numeric result ceiling is frozen
evidence_determinations.tool_shapes: PARTIAL_COMMON_DENOMINATOR_ONLY: one query maps to WebSearch({query}) and web.run(search_query); one URL maps to WebFetch({url,prompt}) and web.run(open), but response representations and option surfaces differ
evidence_determinations.web_policy_counter: AMBIGUOUS: call_ceiling=2 has no frozen unit or relation to operation ceilings; design-clarification-v2 proposes a conservative aggregate dispatch interpretation pending review

independent_review.warning: Neither the proposed WEB_POLICY interpretation nor any common-denominator field is frozen authority until an independent reviewer and the design owner explicitly accept a successor artifact.

official_public_sources.observed_fact: Agent SDK WebFetch requires url and prompt and optionally accepts offset; WebSearch requires query and optionally accepts allowed_domains or blocked_domains.
Claude server web-search max_uses counts searches, including failed searches, while provider execution can repeat internally; allowed domains include subdomains by default.
Claude server web-fetch accepts max_uses, domain controls, and content bounds; redirect chain and provider-internal HTTP details are not exposed as a common Agent SDK input contract.

Anthropic server-tool domain filters automatically include subdomains and web fetch matches domains only, which conflicts with an exact-host/no-implicit-subdomain policy unless adapters enforce exact hosts themselves.
Official Codex v0.167 source exposes a broad web.run command surface and allowed-domain configuration, not the proposed one-query/one-URL-only policy.

smallest_safe_design_amendment: create one additive source-authority successor that enumerates exact ASCII official hostnames and states whether paths are constrained; do not edit or reinterpret the frozen cutoff in place

create one reviewed design successor that defines WEB_POLICY.call_ceiling as aggregate per-cell adapter-dispatch reservations or chooses another explicit unit, preserves tool ceilings 2 and 6, and freezes a separate numeric result ceiling
define exact redirect/final-origin disposition, including UNKNOWN_NO_REPLAY when a provider does not expose evidence needed to enforce source eligibility
pin exact adapter schema snapshots and bind them to the named local binary identities; keep source/archive identity distinct from source-to-binary and live tool-readback evidence
only after CLEAN independent review, implement a disabled exact manifest/schema/verifier/test package; activation and countability remain separate decisions
